'''{{PAGENAME}}''' {{Lang|zh=驺马}} is a NPC Grocery Vendor of [[Jade Steed Itinerant]] found at [[Xuanfang Hold]], [[Mengzhou]] region. 

==Location==

==Shop==


{{Dialogue Start}}
==Idle==
:'''Zouma:''' What the Hold sells, I sell. What it doesn't, my [[Jade Steed]] hauls in and I sell, too.

==Dialogue==

:[[File:Grocery Store Map Marker.png|25px]] I want some medicines.
:;(Open Shop)
::'''Zouma:''' The Jade Steed may be small, but it's got a bit of everything. See if anything catches yer eye?
:;(Purchase)
::'''Zouma:''' Hauled that all the way in from Shaftpost Yard myself. Fine goods, guaranteed!
:;(If not amount of [[Shell Credit]]s)
::'''Rover:''' (I'm running low on Shell Credits. Maybe I'll come back another time.)
:{{DIcon}} Chat
::'''Zouma:''' Me and Mahe from Jinzhou? We keep to our own roads. Couldn't be less related.
::'''Zouma:''' At his prices, only Jinzhou folk too lazy to shop around would buy from him.
::'''Zouma:''' I do business differently. Even with transports from Shaftpost Yard to Xuanfang Hold, I keep my prices fair.
::'''Zouma:''' And of course, I owe it all to this trusty little fellow. Jade Steed, once we're sold out, where shall we wander? Anywhere you like, I'll take ye.
:{{DIcon|Exit}} Leave
{{Dialogue End}}
